resource_rule.measure: Sum of libproc resident bytes rounded up per member to KiB over owned process group; sampled, not continuous peak
resource_rule.failure: Stop above 40 GiB, after three consecutive unavailable observations, or immediately after a sampler timeout; retain all partial evidence. Unknown native/group exit blocks every subsequent child.

semantics.schedule: Graph seed then twelve fixed manifest cases. Sizes 1024,4096,16384,65536,262144,1048576 ascend with distance/shuffled twins adjacent. Graph seed two reverses the complete order, including twin order. Each child runs one checked warmup and six timed repetitions, balancing every solver once in every position. Seed and order remain confounded.
semantics.timing_boundary: Original tuple-input/native-result boundaries. KKT and both Boruvka continuations time problem conversion and temporary input destruction; returned-result validation/destruction are outside the interval. UTC/CPU envelopes are slightly wider than steady elapsed.
semantics.comparison: Compare KKT directly with all five competitors in the same child, graph seed, sampling seed and repetition. Pool all twelve paired trial ratios per case and retain each graph's six-trial median. No historical timing is pooled, normalized or replaced.
semantics.purpose: Prospectively test the existing leaf_distance4/leaf_shuffled4 twins at all six declared sizes and density32, using the exact frozen eighth-sampling candidate with compressed verifier queries and unchanged five controls. Completed half-policy held-out data motivate this known family; no historical timing is pooled. Twins preserve topology, IDs, labels, physical order and cheap leaves; all core edge ranks change from dyadic ancestry ordering to shuffled ordering. Rank weights need not satisfy the triangle inequality; these are engineered constructions, not an application prevalence claim. No domain or resource-ceiling relaxation or new generator. This single-binary study cannot estimate the effect of changing sampling probability.
semantics.clock_semantics: Steady elapsed and process CPU remain separate. Clock flags are descriptive, never a reason to trim or correct data. UTC reversals remain in raw endpoints. Power-log correlation uses actual Sleep/Wake/DarkWake transitions; Wake Requests do not close sleep.
semantics.power_semantics: No verified sleep inhibition is inferred. An absent logged overlap is not proof of an awake, quiet host. Power auditing is post-capture only and never launches pmset automatically.
semantics.certificate_scope: Independent native reference certificate once per child, then exact unique-MST ID/tuple validation for every warmup and timed call.
semantics.sampling_semantics: One fixed scalar eighth-sampling policy, compressed queries, and one starting sampler seed. Six timed repetitions reset that seed and reuse each graph/forest realization; they are not six independent sampled forests. No half-policy child or historical timing enters this campaign.
semantics.crossover: Evaluate every earlier/later measured size pair with exact rational graph medians. All four graph/clock medians must exceed one at the lower endpoint, be at most 0.90 at the upper endpoint, and remain at most 0.90 at every larger measured size. Keep all 150 endpoint pairs, all 60 point classifications and 10 family/comparator summaries. No monotonicity or interpolation assumption.

power_audit.limitation: External log provided; query success/retention coverage not established here. No raw private power events are copied into the analysis.

aggregation: Compare KKT directly with all five competitors in the same child, graph seed, sampling seed and repetition. Pool all twelve paired trial ratios per case and retain each graph's six-trial median. No historical timing is pooled, normalized or replaced.
